scope.purpose: Task041 V3 R1/R2 implementation, two sequential component runs, and R4 document closeout
scope.new_runs_semantics: false applies only to the R4a/R4b document phase; the full V3 record contains one measured R2 baseline and one measured optimized R2g run
scope.full_service_scope: two closed R2 sequential representative-component service runs are measured; full dual-side qualification is not established
scope.document_closeout: R4a/R4b documentation only; no new computation

global_swap.semantics: shared-host diagnostic; not the job swap authority
shared-host diagnostic; not the job swap authority

configuration_identity.semantic_note: physical_sha256 and resolved_sha256 are logical identity fields read from each consumer summary; resolved_config.json is separately hashed as a closed file. The two resolved values happen to equal the corresponding file SHA in both retained runs, but the logical and file hashes are distinct fields.

baseline.evidence_source_note: Use the R2 baseline own summary/finalizer and R2b analysis; r2g_completion_index is retained as a separate historical index and does not bind every baseline artifact.

optimized.evidence_source_note: Use the R2g optimized run and R2h v1/v2 corrections; the optimized completion evidence is not a second baseline binding.

fixed_eight_measured.scope: fixed representative eight apply rows only; not full consumer wall

full_service_reference_seconds.interpretation: full service unit wall; not additive with fixed-eight apply wall

bottom.semantics: sum of each RHS logging-rank max diagnostics; not a campaign rank maximum, not a parent wall, and component maxima are not summed into wall

top.semantics: sum of each RHS logging-rank max diagnostics; not a campaign rank maximum, not a parent wall, and component maxima are not summed into wall

bottom.semantics: sum of each RHS logging-rank max diagnostics; not a campaign rank maximum, not a parent wall, and component maxima are not summed into wall

top.semantics: sum of each RHS logging-rank max diagnostics; not a campaign rank maximum, not a parent wall, and component maxima are not summed into wall

s0_old_statistics.semantics: formal/modal timings are sums of per-RHS logging-rank max diagnostics, not parent wall; nested component fields are not additive

rank0_or_component_diagnostics.semantics: local or per-RHS diagnostic values; MPI.MAX/nested fields are not summed into a critical path

cost_probe_8.status: S0 cost_probe only; distinct from R2g fixed-eight apply

outer_20.status: S0 outer diagnostic rows; not added to formal or fixed-eight wall

sample_32.status: modal_976 minus formal_1920; not part of formal projection

conditional_side_ratio_scenarios.scope: formal 1920 body only; setup, sample32, cost8 and outer20 remain separate/unknown

formal_projection.missing_for_qualified_prediction: Category-weight assumptions and error bounds must be made more defensible, while full dual admission/capacity, stable condensed-row identity, and the same-contract full-consumer boundary remain required for qualification. A prediction does not require rerunning all 1920 rows solely to exist.

rank0_local_comparison.semantics: logging-rank local accumulated seconds; not an eight-rank array and not a critical-path wall

resources.lifecycle_and_finalizer: refer to compacted R2h v1 and retained R2g index; no nested finalizer/consumer snapshot is duplicated here

comparison.interpretation: two full-service observed ranges only; not a general dual-side memory qualification

lifecycle.qualification_boundary: side lifecycle only; no dual-side simultaneous construction evidence
lifecycle.created_total_semantics: cumulative across bottom and top; one owned side set per side
lifecycle.simultaneously_live_peak_semantics: maximum observed side diagnostics at a lifecycle boundary, not cumulative creation count

identity_review.question: whether numeric PETSc global indices identify the same physical condensed FE degree of freedom across fresh runs

cross_run.physical_order: run-local PETSc algebraic order after side condensation; no retained binding maps each position to a mesh entity, orientation, MPC/active row, or stable FE basis key

selected_packet_mapping_check.interpretation: the available topology/local-to-global hashes describe the selected packet mixed space (global_mixed_size=11605), not a persisted map for the 132300 condensed response rows; canonical_mapping and trace_mapping are consumer-reconstructed

missing_minimum_fields: stable geometric/topological entity plus local orientation/FE basis index
MPC expansion/constraint or active-row mapping for every response entry
persisted map from response row 0..132299 to that key in both runs
identity_review.recoverability: not recoverable from retained response/checkpoint/packet artifacts alone; only an already closed artifact containing the missing one-to-one response-row map could change this, and no rerun or new canonicalization is performed

checked_sources_and_artifacts.finding: response and retained packets receive owned arrays plus ownership_range; no cross-run physical-row key is emitted
checked_sources_and_artifacts.role: response probe and retained checkpoint call sites

checked_sources_and_artifacts.finding: schema records identity/global_size/rank/size/ownership_range/shard hashes and metadata, not geometry or FE-row keys
fixed contract binds side/branch/audit_index/formal_column/branch_ordinal and source packet hashes, not condensed response-row keys
checker verifies fixed identity, ownership, shard/hash/finite data and raw audits; it has no geometric response-row map

diagnostic_only_numeric_position_differe.interpretation: approximately sqrt(2) relative differences are retained as unverified-numbering diagnostics, not a numerical Gate failure or pass; artifact hash differences are provenance only
diagnostic_only_numeric_position_differe.method_prerequisite_not_proven: the same physical row key must occupy the same numeric position in both runs
diagnostic_only_numeric_position_differe.method_used_for_diagnostic_only: concatenate each run's own contiguous ownership ranges by numeric PETSc global index, then compute global L2 differences

action_transfer_gate.meaning: linear action/transfer equivalence only; it does not establish response-vector row identity across fresh runs

approximate_ksp_response.semantics: The 1e-11 value is the basic linear action/transfer diagnostic threshold. Each response uses its original explicit residual <=1e-2 and positive reason. There is no formal cross-run response-difference gate while physical row identity is unproven.

s1f.interpretation: retained negative dual-side construction evidence; not re-run or reclassified

h3.evidence: retained in prior H3/H4 compact and reports; not merged with R2 pairing status

corrected_hash_fields.note: R2g index transcription correction; retained index is not rewritten
R2g index transcription correction; retained index is not rewritten

ledger.charge_note: R4b charge is one shared-ledger append for the two recorded ABI/document-check attempts, the harness-only self-check failure, and the corrected short self-check/diff; no PDE/MPI/service work is included.

not_run: PDE/MPI/service execution in R4a/R4b documentation closeout

merge_boundary.production_numerical_core: R2c A1/A2 changes are retained research changes; ordinary/default behavior remains unchanged
merge_boundary.reusable_runner_watchdog: R1 service/supervisor interfaces are retained as reviewed infrastructure; no new framework here
merge_boundary.checker_benchmark: R1 fixed-RHS checker and R2h offline compact evidence retain raw recomputation boundaries
merge_boundary.compact_evidence_docs: R4 Response V4, setup/recovery, summary, test summary and registry/progress entries plus negative evidence
merge_boundary.research_only: task041_schur_speed_v2 sequential component and A1/A2 optimized route remain unqualified opt-in research
merge_boundary.do_not_merge: incident-specific orphan sampler, fixed-PID takeover, large raw artifacts, and any unqualified production promotion; negative-result docs/compact remain retainable evidence
